caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted bust of a woman, oriented with her head slightly tilted back and towards the left. Her skin is a light beige color with pinkish tones, and she has brown hair styled back and adorned with a small red flower and green foliage. She wears a gold beaded necklace around her neck. The upper garment covering her shoulders is intricately decorated with red and pink roses, green leaves, and swirling ornamental patterns in shades of green and red. The background is plain and neutral, without any distinguishable setting or secondary objects. The composition centers solely on the bust, emphasizing its detailed carvings and painted features.
title: Figurehead
